text:
Bitcoin stabilized above $64,150, attempting to establish firm support after a week of $390 million in spot ETF outflows. Digital asset sentiment received structural support as the U.S. Treasury Department issued a landmark Notice of Proposed Rulemaking under Section 3 of the GENIUS Act, codifying a federal licensing regime for payment stablecoin issuers effective January 2027.

Institutional attention is fixated on Washington, where the SEC abruptly canceled its 'Regulation Crypto' open meeting amid Wall Street pushback, shifting focus to Wednesday's high-stakes White House digital asset innovation summit with industry leaders.

Broader macroeconomic markets remain in a holding pattern as Treasury yields consolidate ahead of tomorrow’s July FOMC meeting minutes release. With equity indices hovering near record valuations, digital asset performance remains tethered to whether central bank commentary signals an actionable path toward policy rate normalization at Jackson Hole.
